best_window: Early morning to late morning before wind builds
report_text:
The model expects 15-24 ft of visibility, resulting in a B grade. Conditions are favorable overall, with dry recent conditions and an easing wave trend supporting useful clarity. Residual uncertainty keeps the forecast below exceptional A-grade conditions.

The tide contribution is more neutral because a reliable direction is not available. The next high tide at 5:12 PM could still change nearshore water movement, so local clarity may vary.

Overall, the forecast is favorable for diving. Sheltered coves and deeper water may hold the clearest conditions, while exposed coastline and sandy entries could be less consistent.
